items.note: The focused header search has a pink halo inside an ink ring. Its results open in a white panel with an ink hairline, a static hard shadow, a quiet count line and a muted section label on each row. The lemon hero behind it holds a 96px headline, a black CTA beside an outline button and thick stickers cropped at the edges. This is close to the hairline-and-hard-shadow chrome of 01/07; only the navy clear glyph breaks the ink palette.

Dark mode follows 11: black ground, a raised dark results panel, the lemon band and its stickers unchanged, and a pink CTA. The trailing header cell is a dark-grey block, where 11 has a solid pink full-height block, and the clear glyph is still navy.

The results popover is a clean white ink panel with a hard shadow under the pink-haloed field, and the lemon hero keeps cropped thick stickers like 09. Two things are cruder than 10: the hero lead and its full-width buttons run to the screen edges with no gutter, and the header stacks its two utility links in a lopsided bordered cell.

The no-match result is a dashed ink box inside the popover, with a solid search glyph and one sentence that says what happened and what to try. This is 06's dashed empty state carried into a menu, clear and in the language.

The same dashed empty box sits on the dark raised panel and still reads clearly, with the band and stickers unchanged. As in the other dark states, the trailing header block is grey instead of 11's pink.

The dashed empty message wraps well inside the popover, which properly covers the hero headline as an overlay. The screen around it has the same edge-to-edge hero text and buttons and the same cramped two-link header cell as the other phone states.

The collapsed group shows a turned chevron in a sidebar list with a black current pill. Beside it, a compact lemon header band holds the breadcrumb, a section-size title and the lead, closed by an ink seam, much like 06. Prose, an ink-ruled table of contents, outline-pill tabs and a framed code block follow on paper.

In dark mode the current pill turns white as in 11, and the lemon header band keeps ink text. The code block is a raised box with a hairline. The band meets the black body with no visible seam, which is acceptable but softer than 11's crisp edges.

After a copy, the button reads 'Copied' with a teal status dot and stays lifted on a hard black shadow. It is a clear, physical confirmation in the 05 button language, inside an ink-framed code box with a ruled header.
The copied button keeps its dot and a lifted white-35% shadow on a raised dark box. It reads clearly, though the lift is fainter than in light, as the spec's dark shadow implies.

The first screen shows the compact lemon header band, with breadcrumb, title and lead and even padding, much like 10. The table of contents below has an ink rule. The copied button itself falls below the first screen, and the header carries the same lopsided utility-link cell.
Keyboard focus on the search field draws the spec's pink halo band inside an ink outline, matching 07's pink-edged focused field. It is clearly visible on the white bar and does not move anything.
The same pink halo and ring show clearly on the dark field. The hero below keeps its band, stickers and pink CTA, faithful to 11.

Focus on the brand link is a black ring that hugs the wordmark with no offset and cuts it off from its version tag. It is cruder than the offset rings in 05, and it sits in the crowded phone header with the edge-to-edge hero below.

The full-screen menu is a white panel with a ruled header, a title, an outline close button, chevron group labels and a black current pill. It is plain but entirely ink and paper, in the system's pill-marks-position language.

Eight thick stickers: a terminal key, a book, a gear, a disc, a card, an eraser, a stopwatch and a key. Each has an even ink outline and a deep straight-down strip on a flat band ground, the same construction as 01's coins and 03's tools. The white disc used for the resources tile reads as a generic token, close to the spec's example disc, rather than as its topic.
A periwinkle tag with a full lower strip, a hole and two ruled lines sits on lemon. It is a thick, nameable object of the page's own topic, built to the recipe at the reference's craft.

Hero stickers are bound to the scroll-linked drift. The frames hold still with no scroll, and nothing animates on load. This matches the spec's sparse, physical motion and the reference's stillness at rest.

findings.summary: On phones the hero lead and its stacked full-width buttons run to the screen edges with no side gutter. The header squeezes its two utility links into a lopsided bordered cell beside the search, and the focus ring hugs the wordmark with no offset. Reference 09/10 keeps a 16px+ gutter and one tidy header row.

In dark mode the header's trailing action cell is a dark-grey block rather than 11's solid pink full-height block. In both modes the search clear glyph is navy, a colored icon outside the ink palette. This was already noted in rc.4 and is still open on a new product.

One section sticker is a plain white disc with an inner ellipse and a line, close to the spec's example token. It does not read as the section it stands for, while the reference's stickers can each be named at a glance.
